note: 25 Nov 2026 (the owner): trimmed to what 14-year-olds produce: rehearsed chunks plus a short detail, about 120 words of discussion. Every turn shows the chunk repertoire teachers coach for the judges: giving a view, agreeing and disagreeing, linkers, moving on, asking. Beatriz: one chunk and a detail. Tomás: two or three chunks joined.

Starting and moving on: So, which one shall we choose?
Disagreeing: I see what you mean, but…
OK, we don't agree, and that's fine.

stages.t: Let's start with learning online.
I think it's useful, because you can watch it again.
Really? I'm not so sure.
In my opinion, it's easy to get distracted.
For example, I start a maths video, and then I watch football!
Ha! That's true.
What about keeping in touch?
Personally, I believe that's the most important one, because my cousins live in London.
Do you agree?
Yes, I agree.
I think finding information is important too.
That's a good point, but not everything online is true.
That's why we always have to check.
What about being creative?
I think it's fun, because I make videos.
Exactly!
If you ask me, it's the most fun.
However, it's not the most useful.
So, which one shall we choose? I think learning online.
I see what you mean, but I'd go for keeping in touch,
because friends are very important at our age.
You're right. Let's choose that.
OK, let's go for keeping in touch.
Let's start with studying with friends.
I think it's helpful, because you can ask questions.
I agree.
For me, it's very helpful before a test.
However, sometimes we just talk about football!
Ha! What about getting a tutor?
I think it's a good idea.
Really? I'm not so sure.
In my opinion, it's too expensive.
Not every family can pay for it.
You're right.
I think a study timetable is better, because it's free.
Exactly!
Personally, I believe a timetable helps you to plan.
For example, I put my plan on the wall.
What about getting enough sleep?
I think it's very important.
I couldn't agree more.
If you don't sleep, you can't remember anything.
Do you sleep well before exams?
Not really! So, which one is the most helpful? I think sleep.
I see what you mean, but I'd go for a study timetable,
because then you have time to sleep too!
Hmm, I'm not sure. I still think sleep is more important.
OK, we don't agree, and that's fine.
Let's start with working in a café.
I think it's a good idea, because there are lots of tourists.
That's true, but in my opinion, it's hard work.
For example, my cousin works eight hours a day!
Really?
I think babysitting is better, because I love children.
I see what you mean, but personally, I believe it's a big responsibility.
However, it's easy to find.
What about selling things online?
I think it's easy.
Exactly!
For example, I sold my old bike in two days.
The only problem is that you soon have nothing to sell!
Ha! What about giving lessons to younger children?
If you ask me, that's the best idea, because explaining things helps you learn.
Do you agree?
Yes, I agree.
So, which one shall we choose?
I'd go for giving lessons,
because you earn money and you learn at the same time.
You're right. Let's choose that one.
OK, let's go for giving lessons.
Let's start with healthier school meals.
I think it's a good idea, because we eat at school every day.
I agree.
In my opinion, it would help a lot.
But do you think students would eat them?
Hmm, maybe not.
What about banning fizzy drinks?
Really? I'm not so sure.
If you ban something, teenagers want it more.
For example, when our school banned phones, everyone hid them!
Ha! That's true.
I think more PE lessons are better, because we sit down all day.
Exactly!
Personally, I believe a sports club is even better, because you can choose your sport.
What about lessons about mental health?
I think they're important.
I couldn't agree more.
For example, lots of my friends feel stressed before exams.
So, what should the school do first? I think more PE lessons.
That's a good point, but I'd go for mental health lessons,
because health isn't only about your body.
You're right. Let's choose that.
OK, so mental health lessons first.
Let's start with recycling at home.
I think it's easy, and everyone can do it.
That's true, but in my opinion, it's only a small step.
What about using public transport?
I think it's a good idea,
but the buses here are often late.
Exactly! That's the problem.
If you ask me, Funchal has too many cars.
However, the buses must get better first.
What about joining a beach clean-up?
I did one last year, and I loved it.
Really? That's great!
Personally, I believe it's important on an island.
For example, my class collected three bags of plastic.
I think buying fewer clothes is important too, because fast fashion is bad for the planet.
I see what you mean, but it's hard for teenagers.
Everyone wants new clothes!
So, which one shall we choose? I think the beach clean-up.
I'm not so sure. I'd go for public transport,
because it means fewer cars every day.
Hmm, I still prefer the beach clean-up.
OK, we don't agree, and that's fine.
Let's start with eating meals together.
I think it's nice, because you can talk about your day.
I agree.
For me, dinner is the only time my family is together.
However, my brother always watches videos!
Ha! Mine too.
What about going on holiday?
I think it's fun.
Really? I'm not so sure.
In my opinion, holidays can be stressful.
For example, last summer we waited six hours at the airport!
Oh no! I think visiting grandparents is important too.
I couldn't agree more, because they have amazing stories about Madeira.
Do you visit yours?
Yes, every Sunday.
What about playing games at home?
If you ask me, games are great for the whole family.
For example, we play cards at Christmas.
So, which one shall we choose? I think going on holiday.
I see what you mean, but I'd go for eating meals together,
because you do it every day.
That's true. Let's choose that.
OK, let's go for eating meals together.
